notes.title: Bumpy Grumpy LIVE!
notes.content:
This Saturday at the fabulous Wonderville arcade in Brooklyn I will be hosting an in-person Bumpy Grumpy championship on a physical arcade cabinet! I love that you all play the game at home, but it's a whole other experience playing on a machine in front of people. 

If you live in the NYC area come on out and let's play games, chat, and have a good time! 
I will be there in person. Let's talk games!
If you don't live there, please tell your friends to show up in your place and give me a high five!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119462/0a86a6c17df3b900bfa17964c92589ee73272ba9.png[/img]

Don't forget to RSVP. 
It's this Saturday from 6-8pm. 
[url=https://www.wonderville.nyc/events/bumpy-grumpy-arcade-tournament]https://www.wonderville.nyc/events/bumpy-grumpy-arcade-tournament[/url]

notes.title: Bug Fix: Stats for Cutting Off Drivers
notes.content: This fixes an issue in which stats for "how many drivers you cut off behind/in front" was not being saved properly and was getting reset each time you restarted the game.

notes.title: Bug Fixes: Traffic Milking and Duplicating Papers
notes.content:
Fixed the devious bug where you could get infinite points at traffic lights (Thanks to Kyper for finding this.)
Also fixed the bug where you could beat the game with 13 papers, instead of the proper 12 papers. (Multiple players helped point this out, thanks).

notes.title: "Hide Top Menu" option added, and sfx glitch fixed.
notes.content:
-Added new menu option to hide the top menu. This still submits scores to the leaderboard, and does achievements. It just doesn't show the menu.
-fixed a glitch when adding credits, in which the sound didn't always play properly or was cut off.

notes.title: Achievement fixed
notes.content: The Achievement for hitting drivers that cross the lane at a traffic light with a spike mace was not triggering before. It's fixed now!

notes.title: Leaderboard patch!
notes.content:
We fixed a small bug in the leaderboard viewing. 
The scores were fine, but you couldn't view anything past the top 10. 
Fixed now! 
You can page up/down with the arrow keys or your controller. View your friends, top scores too!
Enjoy!
